card.name: Antibiotic dose schedule before day counts
card.fires_on: The space or small word right before a number of days in an antibiotic dosing line, such as 'for at least' or 'every 12 hours' followed by '10 days'. It appears in infection treatment schedules like sinusitis, pelvic inflammatory disease, epididymitis and chlamydia.

modes.label: Before duration after dose
modes.description: Gap after a dose and frequency, just before the number of treatment days.

modes.label: After 'for at least' or 'for'
modes.description: Gap after 'for' or 'for at least' before a day count in an infection regimen.
modes.example: 100 mg, by mouth, twice a day for at least<< >>10 days.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward antibiotic and bacterial wording.
card.plain: It fires at the spot just before the number of days in an antibiotic treatment course.
